note: Haggai prophesied about the glory of the later Temple being greater than the first (see Haggai 2:2). Messiah spoke about the “living water” of the Spirit in the Holy Temple. It was the same day as the traditional water ceremony in the Temple (see John 7:37–39). The memorial of Rabbi Isaac Lichtenstein (of blessed memory), a Messianic Jewish pioneer who died in 1908 CE (5669). He was a Hungarian Orthodox rabbi who became a believer in Yeshua as Messiah. Despite many obstacles on all sides, he refused to give up his Jewish identity.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
